issue_context.title: Property definition and query accept duplicate names
issue_context.body:
The property definition `n=1, n=0` is parsed without error.  When queried, the behaviour depends on the (undefined) ordering.

Kind of reported in #16614

review_comments: Will Overriding global property properties still work with this change?

Yes.

They are merged as property lists not concatenated as strings.
